note: Every market-specific number the Data Analysis process uses, in one place, so adding a market is a configuration entry and never a restructure (operator, 2026-09-04: 'if i wanted to start doing this for gold, could this be applied also?'). The process is the same for every market; what differs is the SOURCES (which ladder gives the gamma book, which bars give price), the UNITS (a tolerance is a number in the book's own points), and the doctrine priors. tools/nightly/patterns.py reads turnTolPts / minBarsDay / barMinutes for the ledger's market; the panel's DEFL_CONT_PTS / DEFL_FWD_BARS are pinned equal to contPts / fwdBars by test_v1570. status: live = the whole loop runs · price only = the HOD/LOD statistics can be built from the couriered bars, no gamma book source yet.
